basis.rule: Use 1.10 as the conservative floor; raise to 1.11 for diagnostic mean <1.085 and 1.12 for mean <1.065. These are review thresholds, not automatic admission.
basis.reason: The 1.04 historical baseline retained obvious semantic mismatches, especially in lower-scoring CJK/Korean pairs.
basis.secondDiagnosticResult: Retained deterministic samples still contained obvious semantic mismatches above 1.10/1.11/1.12, including a sampled de-ko mismatch at 1.234. Score-only retuning is not accepted for 0.11 admission.

default.note: Conservative fallback for an unreviewed direct pair. Explicit pair rules are required before production admission.
